points.description: States that an orthotropic material has 9 (independent) elastic constants. Equivalent wording, such as 'nine independent elastic constants', earns the mark.

States that the material's properties at a point differ along three mutually orthogonal (perpendicular) axes, i.e. the material has three perpendicular planes of symmetry or directional properties along three orthogonal axes. Equivalent wording earns the mark.
